title: Lags Resizer
description: A datapack that sets the users size within a given range using a /trigger command
body:
# Datapack with /Trigger command for resizing
Allows players on a server to change sizes within a balanced range without needing access to commands. 

It is in my opinion an awful implementation, but it does work. No guarantee on this not creating a lot of lag for what it does.


It works like this for the size of 0.67.
```
/trigger resize_067
```

It works like this for the size of 1.33.
```
/trigger resize_133
```
